description.p: Agents Usage is a compact desktop tray utility for viewing usage across local coding-agent accounts.
Removes the final account-row spacing and adds prominent account warning indicators.
Removes the trailing separator from the final visible account row on desktop and phone views.
Adds truthful, actionable provider error feedback and substantially faster phone companion refreshes.
Adds provider plan badges and improves account controls.
Fixes resilient LAN and Tailscale phone pairing, retry token use, and verified Tailscale Serve setup.
Adds OpenCode Go, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, and Grok discovery with provider-native quota capabilities on desktop and phone.
Adds a read-only phone companion, private LAN and Tailscale pairing, and a signed Android application.
